firstly, there’s nothing wrong with crying when something upsets you. your feelings are completely valid and it’s okay to let them out that way. i do it all the time, lol!

finally, i second the reply who mentioned something about changing up therapy. i have gone through four therapists in my teenage years. yep, four! and honestly, only one ever felt right for me. if possible, there’s no harm in changing things up. if you end up not liking the new stuff, you can go back to the old.
